description: A young man in a blue bandana headband and a khaki shirt stands on a sunlit ridge path and holds up a small flat black shoulder pouch in both hands, laughing at how little it is. The clip cuts and he is swinging on a large black expedition rucksack, gripping both shoulder straps. It cuts again and the pack has grown into a tower far above his head: a rolled sleeping mat strapped across the top, and blackened pots, pans and a kettle hung all over the sides and bottom. He leans forward under it with both hands hooked into the straps, knees bent, grinning at the camera as he walks up the ridge; other walkers follow far behind on the path.

de.answer: Er trägt eine sehr schwere Tasche.
de.question: Was trägt der Mann?

es.answer: Está llevando una bolsa muy pesada.
es.question: ¿Qué está llevando el hombre?

fr.answer: Il porte un sac très lourd.
